methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN Secretariat Policy Portal (policy.un.org) is the official public catalog of Secretariat administrative policy issuances: Secretary-General's Bulletins (ST/SGB), Administrative Instructions (ST/AI), Information Circulars (ST/IC), and Policy Guidelines. All content is publicly accessible without authentication.

## Listing
Each document type has a dedicated browse page rendered by Drupal Views as an HTML table with four columns: Year, Symbol, Title, Date Published. Pagination uses a `block_config_key` Drupal token embedded in the first page's HTML; subsequent pages are fetched as `?block_config_key={KEY}&page=N` (0-indexed). Items per page: 25. Total catalog: ~550+ documents across all four types.

## Download
Documents are hosted in the UN Official Documents System (ODS). The ODS symbol access API at `https://documents.un.org/api/symbol/access?s={SYMBOL}&l={LANG}&t=pdf` returns HTTP 302 to the canonical PDF URL at `documents.un.org/doc/UNDOC/GEN/...`. No authentication is required. Language codes: en, fr, ar, zh, ru, es.

## Symbol Patterns
- `ST/SGB/YYYY/N[/Rev.N]` — Secretary-General's Bulletins
- `ST/AI/YYYY/N[/Amend.N]` — Administrative Instructions
- `ST/IC/YYYY/N` — Information Circulars
- `[ORG]/PG/YYYY/N` — Policy Guidelines (e.g. OHRM/PG/2017/1)

## Document Types Mapping
All issuances are authored by the UN Secretariat (issuingBody=SECRETARIAT) and map to the UN_REGULATORY_DOCUMENT schema. After download, ExtractUNSOPExecutor (ingestion.extract_un_sop) extracts structural data: sections, obligations (SHALL/MUST), role assignments, cross-references.

## Limitations
The Drupal search endpoint (/en/search-portal) uses server-side rendering and complex block_config_key tokens — not suitable for keyword search at harvest time. Browse endpoints are the reliable harvest path. The block_config_key is stable per view configuration but may change after Drupal upgrades; the adapter re-extracts it from page 1 on each harvest run.
probeNotes: Probed 2026-07-07. GET /en/browse-source/secretary-generals-bulletins-sgbs → HTTP 200, Drupal HTML, 185 SGBs visible in facet select, 25 rows on page 1, pagination via block_config_key. GET documents.un.org/api/symbol/access?s=ST/SGB/2024/3&l=en&t=pdf → HTTP 302 → documents.un.org/doc/UNDOC/GEN/N24/069/80/PDF/N2406980.PDF (verified 200 application/pdf). Same verified for ST/AI/2022/2 and ST/SGB/2007/6. No WAF, no robots.txt restriction on content pages.
